text_block_list.text:
—With the JBC Classic right around the corner,
while Hokko Tarumae put in her final push behind the scenes...
those fangs were being sharpened keener than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Phew... phew... phew—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Even if I wanted to thank you, words wouldn't be enough.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Turns out there was still something left for me...
Something left to surpass—"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah... it's roaring... it's roaring...!
It's welling up, burning fiercely...!!
—On the day of the JBC Classic.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Tomakomai's star, Hokko Tarumae!
I'm counting on you again today!
(WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
She's in even better shape than before...!
Lately, she's been truly unreal...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
The momentum's definitely with Hokko Tarumae right now!
Today's race is in the bag!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(............Yeah.
I can look over everything here so calmly.
With this—)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: —Whoa, that's top-notch quality, as expected.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Acute-san...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(She's quiet, but carries the presence of a giant tree...!
Even before the race has started, my body is on full alert...!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (I've never seen Ms. Acute like this before...!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
“—In today's race, you see...
I just waaaanted to beat Tarumae-chan so badly that I went and knocked on hell's door again.”

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks to that, I realized that even though
I thought I'd reached the peak long ago,
there's still further I can go.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"This is allll thanks to you, Tarumae-chan.
So—"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
How about stepping aside for me?
Make way to Falco-san.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Heh... Heheh... Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (How strange. Before fear, what wells up inside is—)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san. I think...
I might have gone crazy...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I'm just so happy right now...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "That I get to compete with an Acute-san unlike anything seen before, and show my current brilliance...!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's okay, Tarumae-chan.
"That"... "That" is what makes us—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: It's just an Umamusume's instinct to make dirt shine.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Let's see it, then.
Our contest of brilliance, and the view that lies beyond its end...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's go!
————It's a showdown, Ms. Acute!!
